1 · Hierarchy — radial node-link tree

Encoding: position = parent→child hierarchy, node size = hub-ness (sub-concept count), color = domain. Chosen because a tree shows containment + branching at a glance. Click a node to expand/collapse (dark ring = collapsed). Only structural domains are labeled by default; hover any node to reveal its name.

2 · Magnitude — treemap by domain

Encoding: area = research sources (+1 floor so every concept is visible), nested + tinted by domain. Chosen because a treemap makes part-to-whole magnitude across a hierarchy directly comparable. Hover a tile for its path and source count.

3 · Research depth — top concepts by sources

Encoding: bar length = sources, sorted descending, color = domain. Chosen because ranked magnitude reads fastest as a sorted bar chart.

4 · Freshness — research timeline

Encoding: x = research date, bar height = concepts researched that day. Chosen because recency is a time series; this surfaces the bulk-research window vs. incremental additions. (377 refreshed, 0 stale >90d.)

Generated by scripts/build-concept-tree-viz.mjs from concept-tree/tree.json. Self-contained & offline (D3 vendored locally). Not part of npm run sync:skills.
